related.title: Amitié：跨洋服務維護後的備援餘量
related.titleEn: Amitié: transatlantic maintenance and spare capacity
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學無服務資料預算2 GB；0.2 s通過、1.5 s失敗；若有緩衝需另驗容量與清空時間。 optical_switch_events.csv與未服務資料積分表 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 1 與變更 7.5 GB、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching unserved-data budget2 GB:0.2 s passes and1.5 s fails; buffering requires its own capacity and drain-time validation. optical_switch_events.csv and integrated unserved-data table Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 1 and changed 7.5 GB, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學最壞單路退出餘量至少0；100通過、120失敗；另外列出端口與登陸點共同依賴。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching worst single-route-loss spare must be nonnegative:100 passes and120 fails; list common port and landing dependencies separately.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成流量40 Gbit/s、切換中斷0.2 s；擾動為1.5 s，暫不計緩衝，非Grace Hopper實測。 名義式 40e9*0.2/8/1e9 = 1 GB；變更式 40e9*1.5/8/1e9 = 7.5 GB。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 用1 ms時間格積分無服務區間的位元數，再除8轉byte；記錄十進位GB與GiB差異。

合成三路各80、60、50 Tbit/s，總需求100；退出最大路，需求再增為120 Tbit/s。 名義式 (80+60+50)-80-100 = 10 Tbit/s；變更式 (80+60+50)-80-120 = -10 Tbit/s。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 枚舉三個單路退出情境，分別計剩餘能力減需求；最大容量路退出應給最小餘量。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic40 Gbit/s offered load with0.2 s interruption, changed to1.5 s; ignore buffering and do not treat these as Grace Hopper measurements. Nominal 40e9*0.2/8/1e9 = 1 GB; changed 40e9*1.5/8/1e9 = 7.5 GB. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Integrate unserved bits in1 ms intervals and divide by eight; record the distinction between decimalGB andGiB.

Synthetic route capacities80,60,50 Tbit/s with100 demand; remove the largest route, then increase demand to120 Tbit/s. Nominal (80+60+50)-80-100 = 10 Tbit/s; changed (80+60+50)-80-120 = -10 Tbit/s. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Enumerate all three single-route removals and compute remaining capacity minus demand; removing the largest should give minimum spare capacity.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: Twin-field QKD：相位殘差的干涉錯誤
related.titleEn: Twin-field QKD: interference error from phase residual
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學無服務資料預算2 GB；0.2 s通過、1.5 s失敗；若有緩衝需另驗容量與清空時間。 optical_switch_events.csv與未服務資料積分表 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 1 與變更 7.5 GB、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching unserved-data budget2 GB:0.2 s passes and1.5 s fails; buffering requires its own capacity and drain-time validation. optical_switch_events.csv and integrated unserved-data table Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 1 and changed 7.5 GB, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學相位錯誤預算0.02；10度通過、30度不足；若δ隨機須平均sin²而非把平均δ直接代入。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching phase-error budget0.02:10 degrees passes and30 fails; for random delta average sin squared rather than substituting the mean phase.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成流量40 Gbit/s、切換中斷0.2 s；擾動為1.5 s，暫不計緩衝，非Grace Hopper實測。 名義式 40e9*0.2/8/1e9 = 1 GB；變更式 40e9*1.5/8/1e9 = 7.5 GB。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 用1 ms時間格積分無服務區間的位元數，再除8轉byte；記錄十進位GB與GiB差異。

合成固定相位殘差10度；擾動為30度，不加入背景或幅度不平衡。 名義式 sin(radians(10)/2)**2 = 0.00759612 wrong-port fraction；變更式 sin(radians(30)/2)**2 = 0.0669873 wrong-port fraction。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 用(1−cosδ)/2獨立驗算，兩輸出比例總和應1；δ=0與180度分別給0與1。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic40 Gbit/s offered load with0.2 s interruption, changed to1.5 s; ignore buffering and do not treat these as Grace Hopper measurements. Nominal 40e9*0.2/8/1e9 = 1 GB; changed 40e9*1.5/8/1e9 = 7.5 GB. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Integrate unserved bits in1 ms intervals and divide by eight; record the distinction between decimalGB andGiB.

Synthetic fixed phase residual10 degrees changed to30 degrees, excluding background and amplitude imbalance. Nominal sin(radians(10)/2)**2 = 0.00759612 wrong-port fraction; changed sin(radians(30)/2)**2 = 0.0669873 wrong-port fraction. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Independently use(1−cos delta)/2; both output fractions must sum to one and0/180 degrees give0/1.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
